note: Micon submodule: auto-icons local-task tabs via hook_menu_local_tasks_alter(), setting each tab title to micon($title)->addMatchPrefix('local_task')->setIconOnly($config->get('icon_only')). Ships micon_local_task.micon.icons.yml mapping local_task.view->fa-eye, local_task.edit->fa-edit, local_task.delete(regex)->fa-trash, etc. One config: micon_local_task.config.icon_only (bool, default false), edited at /admin/structure/micon/local-task (permission administer micon). Medium reads the live icon_only value; hard sets icon_only to true. Grounded in the real config object.

evals.prompt: What single setting does micon_local_task expose, what does it do, and where is it configured?
evals.expected_output: micon_local_task.config -> icon_only (boolean, default false): when true, local-task tabs render icon-only, otherwise icon + label. Configured at /admin/structure/micon/local-task (permission administer micon).

evals.prompt: How does micon_local_task decide which icon to put on a local task tab like 'Edit'?
evals.expected_output: hook_menu_local_tasks_alter() sets the tab title to micon($title)->addMatchPrefix('local_task'), so Micon looks up local_task.<title> in the shipped micon_local_task.micon.icons.yml definitions (e.g. local_task.edit -> fa-edit).

evals.prompt: In micon_local_task's shipped icon definitions, which icon is used for the View tab and which for Delete?
evals.expected_output: local_task.view -> fa-eye and local_task.delete (regex ^local_task.delete) -> fa-trash, from micon_local_task.micon.icons.yml.

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the live micon_local_task configuration and report whether local task tabs are set to render icon-only (the value of icon_only).
evals.expected_output: icon_only is TRUE: micon_local_task.config.icon_only = true, so tabs render icon-only.

evals.prompt: On this site, configure micon_local_task so that local task tabs render as icon only (no text label), and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: micon_local_task.config.icon_only = true (set via config:set micon_local_task.config icon_only true, or the form at /admin/structure/micon/local-task).
